authority.sourceInspection: Public whole canonical sources read only; no upstream runtime/provider/SDK capture executed for this candidate.

nativeProfile.toolResultAdmission: Caller supplies mandatory pure Action<JsonData>; contract tests delegate to existing PiSharp.Agent.ToolResultValueCodec.Read. No Agent/provider dependency in Runtime.
nativeProfile.mutationTranslation: Immutable host-owned snapshots and explicit returned patches replace JS in-place mutation/aliasing. Alias side effects with no returned patch are not emulated; qualification/approval remains mandatory.
nativeProfile.validationDifferences: Strict duplicate/trailing-comma/comment/scalar/finite/depth/size admission; malformed typed results diagnosed rather than reproducing unsafe runtime casts. Numbers retain raw lexemes; finite-double admission is a bound, not JS numeric equality.
nativeProfile.cancellationDifference: Native operation/session/extension lifetime tokens retained separately; host-requested cancellation propagates instead of being swallowed by input/tool-result catches.
nativeProfile.reentrancyDifference: Maximum per-dispatcher depth8/concurrent32; immediate admission failure, no wait on a semaphore, no lock across plugin await. Does not qualify unrestricted nested tool/session work.
nativeProfile.timeout: No implicit timeout or hard termination of trusted in-process code; awaited cooperative callbacks may require restart if they hang.
nativeProfile.actualExecution: Unexecuted authoring candidate; root offline gate and independent review pending.
